ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_basis_detail: declared facts for periods ending 2010-03-31..2026-06-30; paid facts for the periods the declared tag does not cover (2008-12-31..2009-12-31, 4 facts); paid FY facts for 4 fiscal year(s) inside that span that carry no declared FY fact and no four declared quarterly facts (2010-12-31, 2011-12-31, 2012-12-31, 2013-12-31); the paid tag stopped: its newest fact (2014-09-30) is 4291 days older than the declared tag's (2026-06-30) — declared is primary
dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025 (2025-01-01..2025-12-31) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30
notes: split ratio 0.3333 is tagged at 2 context dates (2014-06-30, 2014-09-30) — one split, read once at 2014-06-30

split ratio 0.3333 tagged at 2014-06-30 is left out — diluted shares 235,000,000 (FY ending 2013-12-31, last filed before 2014-06-30) → 282,000,000 (quarter ending 2014-03-31), ×1.20: the share counts do not move by the ratio, so it is not a split of the common shares (an exchange or conversion ratio, or a split tagged at an earlier context date)

quarterly DPS (declared): 1 quarter(s) filed at different values on the same share basis (2011-12-31: 0.12 (filed 2011-10-27) used, not 0.14 (filed 2012-07-27) — the filing that first reported the quarter (the year-to-date facts do not decide)) — later 10-Ks and comparatives sometimes tag a year-to-date or annual value with a three-month context

dps_basis: declared facts for periods ending 2010-03-31..2026-06-30; paid facts for the periods the declared tag does not cover (2008-12-31..2009-12-31, 4 facts); paid FY facts for 4 fiscal year(s) inside that span that carry no declared FY fact and no four declared quarterly facts (2010-12-31, 2011-12-31, 2012-12-31, 2013-12-31) — the series switches basis where one tag stops; the switch year can double-count or skip one payment (a dividend declared in one quarter and paid in the next)

share_issuance: quarters left out (not a sign error) — quarter ended 2023-12-31: the year-to-date facts decrease (2023-01-01..2023-09-30 = 500,000,000 > 2023-01-01..2023-12-31 = 15,000,000) — no quarter can be derived from them (the quarterly row read -485.0M; typically a line tagged in one filing and not in the next); left out (a missing quarter); quarter ended 2024-06-30: the year-to-date facts decrease (2024-01-01..2024-03-31 = 1,000,000 > 2024-01-01..2024-06-30 = 0) — no quarter can be derived from them (the quarterly row read -1.0M; typically a line tagged in one filing and not in the next); left out (a missing quarter)

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-09-30 and 2026-03-31) — FY2025 DPS 2.02 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.52, 2026-06-30: 0.52) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.5, 2025-06-30: 0.5)
